task: Audit a stochastic meme-image run that claims full-catalog sampling.
target: A run is canonical only when the exact catalog population that was counted and digested is the population passed to the RNG. A real RNG over a search-derived or remembered subset must be classified diagnostic_noncanonical.

task: Evaluate a short, already-comic blog passage where a recognizable reaction meme can easily be made to fit.
target: The evaluator can prefer no meme when the image adds recognition but weakens pacing or overweights the article.

task: Compare a genuine image-meme candidate, an extra witty sentence with no meme texture, and no insertion for the same passage.
target: meme-image does not reward generic witty writing merely because it is funny; the visual candidate must contribute a visual/comedic relation the prose does not already provide.

task: For a beat whose joke is structural or project-specific, compare the best stock template against a custom composition, an original generated visual, and no image.
target: A famous template receives no default advantage; custom/original wins when it expresses the passage-specific visual relation materially better, and no image remains a valid winner.

task: Pairwise-rank finalists with sampled/editorial provenance and template fame hidden until after the ranking.
target: The ranking is based on the exact insertion and visual result rather than rewarding randomness, editorial provenance, or template fame as labels.
